test.title: The game loaded this test version
test.hint: This ticks by itself. Nothing to do.

test.title: Ground a run on the floor
test.hint: Go to the floor that sits just above the ground. Ground tool: pick a run on it, right-click. Ticks itself if the floor is seen.

test.title: Points sit on the floor
test.hint: Fly low beside the floor. The points sit on top of it, not under it. PASS if so.

test.title: Drop a point on the floor
test.hint: Move tool: drag a point onto the floor and let go. Ticks itself if the floor is seen.

test.title: Bridges still work
test.hint: Ground tool: pick a run over a bridge, right-click. The points stay on the deck. SKIP if no bridge is near.
